page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs based on the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core metrics, such as the stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core score, fall into the weak category. Single-threaded gzip compression is poor, placing in the bottom 10% of tested hardware. However, the 24 dedicated physical cores allow the instance to achieve average multi-core performance across stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both cached and uncached reads and writes also remains in the average tier.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge offers moderate resource density. It is suited for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage its 24 dedicated cores, such as software compilation, static web serving, and database operations, where it demonstrates average performance. It is less suitable for single-threaded tasks or applications requiring high-speed local storage. Qualitatively, it represents a standard general-purpose tier where cost efficiency is tied to multi-core utilization rather than raw single-core speed.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance featuring 24 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and 96.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, this KVM-based instance provides a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. It lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, relying on a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. Benchmark data reveals a performance tradeoff: single-core performance is weak, placing in the bottom 25%, while multi-core performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations consistently reach average tiers. This makes the instance suitable for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, and static web serving rather than single-threaded tasks. Qualitatively, it offers standard resource density for general-purpose workloads that benefit from dedicated core allocation.
